description: The agent must: 1) Read each raw JSON intake file and identify which questionnaires are present (PHQ-9, GAD-7, PSS-10, C-SSRS). 2) Compute PHQ-9 scores by summing all 9 items (Case 001=20, Case 002=14, Case 003=8) and correctly interpret severity tiers per SKILL.md. 3) Apply the PROPRIETARY TRAP for PHQ-9 Q9: if Q9 >= 1, an immediate suicide risk assessment must be triggered regardless of total score — this catches Cases 001 and 003 even though Case 003 has only a mild total score of 8. 4) Compute GAD-7 scores and interpret severity. 5) Compute PSS-10 scores using the mandatory REVERSE SCORING for items 4, 5, 7, 8 (the most common trap for generic agents). Correct scores: Case 001=29 (高压力), Case 002=19 (中等压力), Case 003=13 (低压力). 6) Apply C-SSRS risk level logic: Case 001 has method ideation (q3=True) + prior attempt history -> elevate one tier from 中风险 to 高危; Case 003 has ideation without method (q3=False) -> 中危; Case 002 has no ideation (Q9=0) -> no crisis protocol needed. 7) Output the correct intervention actions per risk tier from SKILL.md: 高危 = hotlines 12356 + 400-161-9995 + 24-hour supervision; 中危 = hotline + safety plan + 48h professional evaluation. 8) All three JSON report files must be created with scores, severity labels, risk classification, and intervention actions.
